description: October 6 birthday meaning: Libra decan 2, birthday number 6, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an October 6 birthday falls in Libra, in the second decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Uranus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 6. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Libra is cardinal and air.

sections.heading: Personality of an October 6 birthday
paragraphs: October 6 brings a progressive edge to domestic life. With the Sun around thirteen degrees of Libra, the Uranus-ruled decan encourages independence of thought, while the birthday number 6 is connected with care, family and community responsibility. Read together, they describe someone who keeps a warm, welcoming home but runs it on their own terms, often rewriting inherited traditions.

By noon UTC on October 6, the Sun has normally reached roughly 13° of Libra. That places the date in the Libra decan that astrologers give to Uranus, the second of three. The middle stretch of Libra, roughly October 3 to October 13, takes Uranus as sub-ruler, the planet associated with Aquarius in modern astrology. This tends to turn the sign's interest in fairness towards society at large. Natives are often pictured as idealistic, progressive and drawn to groups, networks and causes. Their relationships may be unconventional, or built on friendship and shared values more than tradition. Uranus brings originality and also a cool, detached streak when emotions run high. Combining their sense of justice with personal warmth usually helps them persuade rather than simply be right.

sections.heading: Numerology of the October 6 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 6th produces a birthday number of 6, unreduced. As the secondary number in a chart, the day of birth hints at how someone naturally contributes to the people around them. The 6 is the number of the household in Pythagorean tradition: care, responsibility, beauty in the home and fairness within the family. Those born on the 6th are often the friend who remembers birthdays and notices when someone is struggling. Their usual lesson is that looking after others works best when they include themselves in the circle of care too.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same October 6 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: October 6 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: October birthdays fall in mid-autumn north of the equator, with turning leaves and earlier evenings, and in mid-spring in the southern hemisphere. Libra holds most of the month, with Scorpio arriving around October 23. In numerology October is month 10, which reduces to 1: a number of new starts and independence, carried here with a 0 that is often read as amplifying it. October 6 is the 279th day of the year (280th in a leap year). In most years Scorpio season is under way by October 24, 18 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for an October 6 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. October 6 is also the birthday of Le Corbusier (1887), Thor Heyerdahl (1914) and Louis-Philippe I (1773).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is October 6?
faq.answer: October 6 is Libra in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Libra, which tradition links with Uranus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on October 6?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On October 6 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 11 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 6 for everyone born on the 6th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on October 6?
faq.answer: By October 6 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on October 6?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with an October 6 birthday are Le Corbusier (1887), Thor Heyerdahl (1914) and Louis-Philippe I (1773). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
